entry.prompt: Dense round-crowned broadleaf tree: one short thick tapered trunk under a wide canopy of four fused chunky rounded lobes, crown wider than tall, a low bushy skirt hiding the roots. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism that reads from above. Solid closed volumes, no individual leaves, no thin branches, hard edges, flat faces. One tree about 3 m tall. Isolated, no ground, no base plate, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Canopy: deep forest green (#3E6B39), sunlit lobe tops olive green (#6F8F46), shadowed undersides (#2C4A2C). Trunk: dark warm brown bark (#5A4632). Bushy skirt: moss green (#5E7A3A). Slightly desaturated so it sits beside cream plaster, dark timber and grey-teal slate buildings and reads darker than harvestable trees. No flowers, no fruit, no text or logos.
